title: DiT and MM-DiT blocks
hook: How a transformer replaces the U-Net: patches become tokens, a time vector scales each block, text and image share attention.

verified.claim: modulate is shift + x (1 + scale), broadcast over tokens.
SD 3 joins text and image for one attention call.
FLUX's double block has separate weights and joined attention.
Latents not divisible by the patch are padded.
The numbers in the lab tables come from the lab, run here.
Titles and the DiT and MM-DiT attributions come from the arXiv API.
The DiT paper zero-initialises the MLP's scale output, which it says makes the full block the identity at the start.

unchecked: We did not run a real DiT in this lesson: every number is from toy sizes.
The statement that most newer models are DiTs is a reading of the comfy/ldm folder, not a count.
The code only shows a loaded checkpoint, not its starting values, so the start at zero rests on the DiT paper.
